title: feat(spec,rest,lint,cli): a form view's title is translated through objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.title, and GET /forms/:slug serves it in the visitor's language
body:
Closes #24969

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changes

A public form could not be titled in more than one language. `FormViewSchema.title` had no translation key: the `_views.VIEW` translation entry named `title` as a rename onto `label`, `translateView` never read `config.title`, and `GET /forms/:slug` answered the top-level `label` from the matched view before translation. A form that declared a title served it in the authoring language, so declaring one replaced a translated heading (the object label) with an untranslated one in every other locale.

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`): `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.title` is a declared key. The `title -> label` alias on that entry is removed, and `heading` and `formTitle` are named as renames onto `title`.
- **Resolver** (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`): `translateView` overlays the key onto a served form item's `config.title` (new `translateFormTitle`), through the same one `_views` read (`lookupViewText`) as the view's `label` and `description`. It follows the rules every other view string follows: only an authored title is translated (a form without one gains none), a missing key keeps the authored title, and an explicit override beats the catalog against the packaged view (ADR-0029 D9.2a, `valueOverridesPackagedBase`).
- **REST** (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`): the served `form.title` is the translated one, because the route already serves the translated view's `config`. The top-level `label` is now taken from the translated view when the view authors a `label`. When the view authors none, the route still answers none, because the translator falls back to the view's machine name and that must not shadow the title. The console's `payload.label ?? form.title ?? objectSchema.label` stays meaningful: all three arrive translated, in the same order.
- **`objectstack validate`** (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`): a new `forms` fact set holds the `_views` keys of every form the composer serves: `formViews.KEY` entries, the default `form` (`form` or its `name`, asked of `expandViewContainer`), and `viewKind: 'form'` items. A `title` key over a form resolves. Over a list view it is refused, as `translation-target-unknown`, with: `View "all_leads" of object "crm_lead" is not a form view, so no title resolves this key.` The fix line points at `_views.VIEW.label`. The default form's key is legal for `title` alone, and its other tails stay non-keys as before.
- **CLI extractor** (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`): it emits `_views.VIEW.title` for every form a container serves, keyed by the composer's runtime name (new `pushContainerFormTitles`), and for a `viewKind: 'form'` item. So `os i18n extract` scaffolds the slot, and `check:i18n-coverage` reports an authored title that a supported locale leaves untranslated.
- **Showcase**: `examples/app-showcase` authors `title: 'New contact'` on `formViews.create`. The new slot raised its untranslated count by one (414 to 415), so the zh-CN bundle now carries `_views.create.title`.

## Why its own key, not the view's `label` key

The card asked for one of two options: reuse `_views.VIEW.label` if `title` aliases `label`, or add a key. I read the schemas. The `title -> label` alias exists only on the TRANSLATION entry (a "did you mean" for a refused key). The authored shapes keep them separate:

- `ViewItem.label` names the view.
- `FormViewSchema.title` is the heading the form draws.
- A container's form entries (`formViews.KEY`, `form`) carry no `label` at all, because `FormViewSchema` declares none. `expandViewContainer` stamps `label: v.label`, which is undefined.
- A `viewKind: 'form'` item can author both, with different text, and the console prefers `label`.

So they are two source strings. If both used one key, one translation would stand for two different strings. The new key mirrors the authored key, the way `emptyState.title` does. It sits in the same `_views` node and uses the same view key, so it adds no second key convention.

## Tests

Measured at head `6f43b6b2e0`, which is merged with `origin/main` `73432299c0`.

- **Repro first.** Commit `87d4974eab` adds the tests before the fix.
- **Reverse verification.** After committing the fix, I restored the five source files to base `7532ea3c08`, in the working tree only. The mutation was confirmed on disk: `translateFormTitle` count 0, `forms.add` count 0, `pushContainerFormTitles` count 0, `servedLabel` count 0. I rebuilt spec, and `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` found the marker in 0 of 232 built files. Results:
  - spec: `6 failed | 162 passed`. The new resolver cases failed, and so did the `title` and `heading` schema cases.
  - rest: `3 failed | 6 passed`. These were the translated title, the label-not-machine-name case and the authored-label case. The "no title" controls stayed green.
  - lint: `3 failed | 188 passed`.
  - cli: `4 failed | 1 passed`.
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATHS`. `git diff HEAD` was empty and `git status --porcelain` was clean. After the spec rebuild, the preflight found the marker in 6 built files.
- **Controls.**
  - A form with no title gains none, and `/forms/:slug` still answers no `label`, so the heading falls back to the translated object label (`工单`).
  - The `label` key does not reach the title, and the title key does not reach the `label`.
  - An `en` request is served as authored.
  - A title edited by an environment overlay keeps the edit. This runs on the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` over a real `SchemaRegistry`.
  - A list view's `label` key is still accepted.
  - The `_views` entry stays closed.
- **Package runs.**
  - Pre-merge, at `32124e9b0a` plus the showcase commit:
    - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 704 files, 21381 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` passed too.
    - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 308 files, 6166 passed.

    - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: 4654 of 4655 passed. The one failure was `boot-preparation-parity.test.ts`, which hit its 5000 ms timeout under shared-box load. It passes alone, and this diff does not touch `serve.ts` or that file.
  - After the merge, re-run on `6f43b6b2e0`:
    - the touched suites passed: spec 3 files/181, rest 2 files/23, lint 1 file/191, and cli 5 files/102 (including `boot-preparation-parity`);
    - `typecheck` passed for rest, lint and cli.
  - The cli `integration` tier is declared to CI.
- **Generated artifacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` reports all 14 up to date. `--fix` regenerated `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`. `check:authorable-surface`, `check:liveness` and `check:strictness-ledger` were already green; the `objects` liveness row is `live` and undrilled.
- **i18n gates.**
  - `pnpm check:i18n`: OK, 10 packages in sync.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`: OK, 14 configs, 621 baselined, none new.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-walk-parity`: OK.

  - `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: OK.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 117 commands on `6f43b6b2e0`, the same list as before the merge. 116 exited 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` is NOT MEASURED: its closure build queued on the shared verify lock behind a sibling run and timed out (exit 99, then exit 3). `check:type-check-coverage` exited 0, and the rest, lint and cli `typecheck` runs above passed.
- **eslint**, narrowed to the 11 touched source and test files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 11 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, and no file was ignored. The config declares no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.

## Review tier

`packages/spec` is a published schema, so this PR owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before it enters the queue (pm-dispatch `references/contract-review.md`). It touches no governed surface, so no Tier S or Tier H landing rule applies.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open PRs on overlapping files.** I checked these after the merge. Only #24947 touches `i18n-extract.ts`, in `pushBulkActionDefs` (`confirmText`), and the hunks do not overlap. No other open PR touches `translation.zod.ts`, `i18n-resolver.ts`, `form-routes.ts` or `validate-translation-references.ts`. #24968 is not open as a PR yet.
- **Inference, not measured: a form `formViews.KEY` that retargets another object** (its own `data.object`). The lint rule files its `_views` key under the form's own binding, as it already does for that form's `label`. `translateView` and the new extractor slot key it under the container object (`ExpandedViewItem.object`). The `label` key already has the same split. No shipped example retargets a form view.
- **Inference, not measured: a `viewKind: 'form'` item.** It is a `ViewItem` whose `name` is spec-qualified as `OBJECT.KEY`. The extractor's `view.name` branch and the lint rule both use the raw `name` as the `_views` key, while `translateView` strips the object prefix. The new title slot follows that branch's existing key, so it inherits the behaviour of `label` there. No shipped example authors one.
- **The default form's `_views.form.label` and `description`** are read by `translateView` for the served `OBJECT.form` item, but lint still calls them non-keys. Its documented reason is that `_views.*` is a list-view convention. This PR registers that key for `title` only and leaves the earlier decision alone.
- `FormViewSchema.title`'s own `.describe()` was not edited to name the key. The translation face documents the key, and editing the describe would churn the JSON schema and docs for no behaviour change.
